claims.statement: For bounded normal A with fixed bounded Borel argument and countable G, a two-sided frame inequality on one finite [0,T0] implies one on each finite [0,T].
claims.limits: No uniform lower constants; continuous observations; no arbitrary semigroup.

claims.statement: Integrated upper observation bound implies locally bounded holomorphic observations at positive complex times.
Under the frame premise, positive-delay windows are frames exactly when A is invertible.
claims.evidence: Elementary consequence of C1 and normal spectral calculus
